title: Report of the Independent International Fact-Finding Mission on Myanmar
supports_claim: The UN fact-finding mission examined hate speech and serious human-rights violations in Myanmar and documented the broader context in which social media was relevant.
limitations: The report addresses a complex conflict with many actors; it should not be read as proving that one recommendation algorithm caused every harm.

title: Investigation into the use of data analytics in political campaigns
supports_claim: The UK ICO's investigation examines the use of personal data analytics in political campaigns, including concerns about Facebook-derived data and political targeting.
limitations: The report covers a historical investigation and does not establish the effect of every targeted message on an individual voter.

title: Cambodian Prime Minister decision
supports_claim: The Oversight Board found that a video containing threats against political opponents violated Meta's violence policy and required removal, criticizing the application of a newsworthiness allowance.
limitations: The Board is an independent body funded by Meta and the decision concerns a single item under Meta policy, not all political-speech moderation.

title: Former President Trump's suspension decision
supports_claim: The Oversight Board upheld restriction of a political leader's accounts but found an indeterminate penalty inconsistent with clear and proportionate rules.
limitations: This decision interprets one platform's policies and does not establish legal rules for CivicBrief.

title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: Artificial Intelligence Act
publisher: Official Journal of the European Union
supports_claim: The EU AI Act establishes risk-based AI rules, including transparency and high-risk classification provisions that require an intended-purpose assessment.
limitations: Applicability depends on final functions, deployment, target market, and other EU law; it is not a legal opinion for CivicBrief.

title: Decree No. 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection
supports_claim: Vietnam's Government published Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection, relevant to reader queries and any future personalization data.
limitations: This source alone does not determine content, election, controller, consent, security, or transfer obligations for CivicBrief.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports_claim: NIST AI RMF describes governance, mapping, measurement, and management activities for trustworthy AI risk management.
limitations: The voluntary framework is not a certification and does not prove that a control is effective.
